description: This file is a JavaScript plugin for jQuery called FancyBox, providing a lightbox-style display for images, HTML content, iframes, and other media. It includes functions for initializing, opening, closing, and navigating through content, as well as handling various content types and user interactions.

methods.name: fancybox
methods.description: Main jQuery plugin method to initialize or invoke the FancyBox functionality on selected elements.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigate to the next item in the gallery.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigate to the previous item in the gallery.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Navigate to a specific position in the gallery.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Center the FancyBox in the viewport.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize the FancyBox structure and event handlers.
